claims.claim: IBC tank for storage of water or any liquid
claims.evidence: Photo shows a standard IBC tote; no evidence of interior condition, prior contents, or chemical residue that would confirm safety for any liquid.
No close-up of cage welds, rust extent, cracks, or stress test shown; only a general exterior view.

risks.proof: Clear shot of the manufacturer plate or embossed liter marking on the tote
risks.if_unproven: priced as smallest common IBC size (worst case)

risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four cage corners and base welds

risks.risk: Plastic cracks, discoloration, or odor from prior contents
risks.proof: Close-up of tank walls and a photo/video of the interior through the cap
risks.if_unproven: priced as contaminated/unsafe for potable use

risks.risk: Cap or outlet valve missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo/video showing cap removed and valve operated, showing flow

risks.risk: Pallet base condition (wood rot, metal corrosion, cracks)
risks.if_unproven: priced as damaged base needing replacement

risks.risk: Age and prior use history unknown
risks.proof: Seller-provided purchase date or batch code photo

proof_requests: Photo of the capacity/volume plate or embossed marking
Close-up of all cage corners, welds, and rust spots
Photo/video of interior through the open cap
Video of cap and outlet valve operation showing flow
Any available documentation of prior contents or purchase date
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a standard IBC tote, so it can be priced at worst case for unverified strength, capacity, and contamination risk pending the listed proofs.
